states.why: a free place is not at zero, it is empty — and it says so (§1 Ziel, §5 Leere Werte). THE SEEDED PROFILE FILLS ALL FOUR BLOCKS, so this state has to be reached with a THINNER one: twelve varied runs leave no free place, and a state nobody can reach is a state nobody verified. `sparse` re-seeds, reloads and re-opens before reading.
